name: harness-project
title: Harness Project
description: [root|init|migrate|context|clean|policy] Set up and steer a harness project: show status, select or move its root, initialize, migrate layout, show context and register its sources and coding repositories, clean history, and set limits and failure policy, including pause, stop, and resume. Shorthand: /hn-project. Context summaries overlap with handoff. Owns retention; harness-timer schedules maintenance. Bare invocation only lists.
author: wzlwit

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: Primary action; omitted means read-only list. context and policy take a verb; without one, context shows its briefing and policy lists. Compatibility aliases remain in SKILL.md. Operation-specific approvals still apply.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Existing parent/controller path for root. Omission only displays locations. Select a valid new path, then prompt to move an initialized previous harness; Move is the default, including no answer. Explicit answers or user instructions override it. A skipped or failed move keeps the new root selected. Invalid paths do not change Root.

inputs.name: current-file
inputs.description: Canonical current-<project>.csv filename. Init accepts it for a new controller; root with this option shows an explicit rename through Board and asks once. Existing files change only after a yes.
